mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT BVTD.BOOKSET_ID booksetId, BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID fundId, BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME finprodName, BVTD.SUBJECT_NO fKmbm, BVTD.SUBJECT_NAME fKmmc, BVTD.CLOSE_PRICE fHqjg, #{fHqbz} as fHqbz,/** 行情标志：0:平均价；1:收市价。固定取收市价 1**/ BVTD.NUM_AMT fZqsl, BVTD.COST fZqcb, BVTD.MARKET_VALUE fZqsz, BVTD.VALUE_INCREMENT fGzZz, BVTD.COST_PERCENT fCbJzBl, BVTD.VALUE_PERCENT fSzJzBl, CASE WHEN NVL(BS.subject_level,BS2.subject_level) IN (1,2) THEN 0 WHEN NVL(BS.GEN_DETSUB_FLAG,BS2.GEN_DETSUB_FLAG) = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS fIsDetail FROM BOK_VAL_TABLE_DATA BVTD LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET BB ON BVTD.BOOKSET_ID = BB.BOOKSET_ID AND BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = #{finprodType} /**[数据字典.金融产品类型.理财金融产品]**/ LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO BASI ON BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = #{finprodType} /**[数据字典.金融产品类型.理财金融产品]**/ LEFT JOIN bok_subject BS ON BS.BOOKSET_ID = BB.BOOKSET_ID AND BS.SUBJECT_NO = BVTD.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN bok_subject BS2 ON BS2.BOOKSET_ID = BB.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND BS2.SUBJECT_NO = BVTD.SUBJECT_NO WHERE BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId} AND BVTD.VAL_DATE = TO_DATE(#{cDate}, 'yyyyMMdd')

SELECT DISTINCT BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID fundId, BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME finprodName, B1.SUBJECT_NO fAcctCode, CASE WHEN B1.O_CCY = 'CNY' THEN 1 WHEN B1.O_CCY = 'USD' THEN 2 END fCurCode, B2.O_AMT fStartBal, B1.TDY_O_C_AMT fDebit, B1.TDY_O_D_AMT fCredit, B1.O_AMT fEndBal, B2.B_AMT fBStartBal, B1.TDY_B_D_AMT fBDebit, B1.TDY_B_C_AMT fBCredit, B1.B_AMT fBEndBal, B2.NUM_AMT fAStartBal, B1.NUM_AMT fAEndBal, CASE WHEN B1.IS_LEAF = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END fIsDetail FROM BOK_BALANCE B1 LEFT JOIN BOK_BALANCE B2 ON B1.BOOKSET_ID = B2.BOOKSET_ID AND B1.SUBJECT_NO = B2.SUBJECT_NO AND B2.BALANCE_DATE = B1.BALANCE_DATE - 1 LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET BB ON B1.BOOKSET_ID = BB.BOOKSET_ID AND BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = #{finprodType} /**[数据字典.金融产品类型.理财金融产品]**/ LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO BASI ON BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = #{finprodType} /**[数据字典.金融产品类型.理财金融产品]**/ WHERE BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = #{prodId} AND B1.BALANCE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{cDate}, 'yyyyMMdd')
